text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends a U-turn prohibition on Marcos Boulevard, between Midland Avenue and Cicerella Crescent east intersection. Prohibiting U-turns will provide a safer environment for all road users along this section of Marcos Boulevard, which is in the vicinity of Charles Gordon Senior Public School.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Marcos Boulevard, between Midland Avenue and Cicerella Crescent (east intersection).
